local p = {}
local data = mw.loadData('Module:Faction/data')

local getArgs = require('Module:Arguments').getArgs
local chara = require('Module:Character')._main

local elites = {
	["Mechanist"] = true,
	["Misery"] = true,
	["Pith"] = true,
	["Raidian"] = true,
	["Sharp"] = true,
	["Stormeye"] = true,
	["Touch"] = true,
	["Tulip"] = true,
}

function p.operators(frame)
	local args = getArgs(frame, {
		wrappers = 'Template:Faction cell'
	})
	return p._operators(args)
end

function p._operators(args)
	local t = {}
	local faction = data[args.name]
	if not faction then
		return "'''N/A'''"
	end
	local seen = {} -- unique results only
	for k, v in pairs(faction.operators) do
		if v.title ~= 'Amiya' -- not Amiya's versions
		and not v.name:find('Reserve Operator')
		and not elites[v.name]
		and not seen[v.name]
		then
			t[#t+1] = v.name
			seen[v.name] = true
		end
	end
	table.sort(t)
	for i, k in ipairs(t) do
		t[i] = tostring(chara{k, gridview=true})
	end
	return table.concat(t)
end

return p
